structuredData.headline: Regency Tanjung Tuan Coastal Homestay Refurbishment — Seafront Apartment Turnkey Renovation in Port Dickson
structuredData.description: A seafront apartment at Regency Tanjung Tuan in Port Dickson refurbished on an RM 30,000 budget within 1 month. Features warm coastal Malay styling with iconic rattan furniture, patterned blue rug, heavy brown drapes framing a sea view, artificial grass balcony, updated bedrooms with hotel-quality linens, wooden cabinetry kitchen with rattan bar stools, and a vintage bathroom with retro olive green tiles and sunken corner tub.
